name: Biological soil crust
desc: A living skin of cyanobacteria, lichens, mosses, algae and microfungi. It binds sand grains against erosion, soaks up scarce rain and fixes nitrogen, but is easily broken by footsteps.
about: Biological soil crusts, often abbreviated as biocrusts, are communities of living organisms inhabiting the surface of soils in arid and semi-arid ecosystems, which form stable aggregates of soil…
